review.result: Both source findings fixed and independently verified; final source/evidence audit passed
fixed: Rejected standalone replay could leave its public report complete; publication now remains incomplete until postflight checks pass.
Attempt and selected-candidate evidence was not bound to ranking; validation now requires ranking-consistent attempts and the first successful terminal attempt.

limitations: Developer-authored correlated diagnostic tasks with eight tasks per split do not establish independent model usefulness or satisfy the proposed 500-task-per-family contract.
Prior full-corpus inspection and deterministic test evaluation are disclosed in the frozen plan.

The primer includes two train demonstration tasks. A one-task primer preflight used a train demonstration, retained no report and produced no artifact in this bundle, and it did not change either prompt or the plan.
Only the validation-selected original prompt was evaluated on test. The primer was not selected and has no test result.
All model failures were semantic mismatches after type acceptance; finite behavior examples do not prove all-input correctness.

The original compiler binary was reused because compiler sources did not change. The selection records its path relative to the repository root and exact hash, plus runtime identity; it is not a portable build receipt.
Cold process timing on a shared machine does not establish warm latency or a speed comparison.
Hashes establish local consistency, not report authorship, unseen test data or protection from rewriting an entire evidence bundle.

Both primer demonstrations and the primer syntax line show a one-argument function, every train task takes one argument, and every validation task takes two, so the primer's validation drop mixes prompt content with an argument-shape change. The test split holds four two-argument interior tasks and four one-argument clamp tasks.

The corpus, split manifest, compiler and provider paths inside each report, and the run directories named beside the checks, are provenance of the machine that ran them and are not part of the checked evidence.
